quests.instruction: A whole rye bread sitting unsliced in the bakery window is called this. What's this word?
quests.question: Loaf
quests.hint: This word means one complete block, not individual slices.
quests.explanation: Well done! A whole, unsliced rye bread is named by this word!
quests.funFact: Bakeries display bread this way so shoppers can pick exactly how it's sliced!

quests.instruction: Lettuce cut from the garden just before lunch hasn't been canned or frozen. Which word fits?
quests.question: Fresh
quests.hint: This word describes food enjoyed at its very peak, soon after harvest.
quests.explanation: Correct! Lettuce cut from the garden just before lunch is enjoyed at its peak, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This kind of food usually has the brightest color and the crispest crunch!

quests.instruction: Celery stalks usually stay connected together in one leafy group at the store. What's this word?
quests.question: Bunch
quests.hint: This word describes many stalks or stems attached as one unit.
quests.explanation: Super! Celery stalks connected together as one unit are described by this word!
quests.funFact: This connected group makes celery easy to carry with just one hand!

quests.instruction: Coffee and warm apple cider are often served in this small container with a handle. What's the word?
quests.question: Cup
quests.hint: This word is smaller than a bowl, meant for sipping.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Coffee and warm apple cider are served in this small handled container, named by this word!
quests.funFact: This container comes in many sizes, from tiny to extra-large!

quests.instruction: A single slice cut from a whole watermelon is called one of these. What's this word?
quests.question: Piece
quests.hint: This word describes one single serving, separated from the rest.
quests.explanation: You found it! A single slice cut from a whole watermelon is named by this word!
quests.funFact: Cutting fruit into these smaller portions makes it much easier to share!

quests.instruction: Candy, a lollipop, and a slice of birthday cake are special foods, not everyday ones. What word describes them?
quests.question: Treat
quests.hint: This word describes food saved for special, fun moments.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Candy, a lollipop, and birthday cake are special foods saved for fun moments, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Enjoying food like this once in a while is a normal part of a balanced diet!

quests.instruction: Grilled chicken, salad, and whole grain bread are all good choices for your body. Which word fits?
quests.question: Healthy
quests.hint: This word is the opposite of a food that's just a sugary treat.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Grilled chicken, salad, and whole grain bread are all good choices for your body, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Doctors say filling most of your plate with food like this helps you grow strong!

quests.instruction: Tea and hot cocoa are both served warm in this small drinking container with a handle. What's this word?
quests.question: Cup
quests.hint: This word names a small drinking container, often with a handle.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Tea and hot cocoa are both served in this small handled container, named by this word!
quests.funFact: This container has been used for warm drinks for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: Bread is often baked and sold as one long, whole piece before it's sliced. What word describes that whole piece?
quests.question: Loaf
quests.hint: This word describes bread in its whole, unsliced shape.
quests.explanation: Yes! Bread baked as one whole, unsliced piece is named by this word!
quests.funFact: Bakers shape dough into this form before it ever goes in the oven!

quests.instruction: A basil leaf snipped straight from the plant hasn't been dried or packaged. What's the word?
quests.question: Fresh
quests.hint: This word describes food at its very best, right after harvest.
quests.explanation: That's right! A basil leaf snipped straight from the plant is at its very best, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Herbs like this often taste much stronger than the dried kind in a jar!

quests.instruction: A chocolate bar, a gummy candy, and a slice of pie are fun foods enjoyed once in a while. Which word matches?
quests.question: Treat
quests.hint: This word describes a food chosen just for fun, not for health.
quests.explanation: Great job! A chocolate bar, gummy candy, and a slice of pie are fun foods enjoyed occasionally, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Many families save food like this for weekends or celebrations!

quests.instruction: Steamed broccoli, brown rice, and baked fish are great choices for a growing body. What's the word?
quests.question: Healthy
quests.hint: This word describes food chosen to help you feel your best.
quests.explanation: You got it! Steamed broccoli, brown rice, and baked fish are all great choices to help you feel your best!
quests.funFact: Food like this gives your body vitamins it needs to grow and stay strong!

quests.instruction: Pickles and peanut butter are both kept fresh inside this glass container. Which word fits?
quests.question: Jar
quests.hint: This word names a round glass container, often with a metal lid.
quests.explanation: Well done! Pickles and peanut butter are both kept fresh in this glass container, named by this word!
quests.funFact: Sealing food inside this glass container can help it stay fresh for a long time!

quests.instruction: One square cut from a whole pan of brownies is called one of these. Which word fits?
quests.question: Piece
quests.hint: This word describes one single portion, not the whole thing.
quests.explanation: Correct! One square cut from a whole pan of brownies is named by this word!
quests.funFact: Sharing food this way is one of the friendliest habits at a party!

quests.instruction: A serving of juice and a serving of milk are measured using this small container. Which word fits?
quests.question: Cup
quests.hint: This word can measure a food amount or hold a warm drink.
quests.explanation: Super! Juice and milk are both measured using this small container, named by this word!
quests.funFact: Bakers use this same word as a measurement for recipes, not just for drinks!

quests.instruction: A carrot just pulled from the garden soil hasn't been cooked or preserved. What's this word?
quests.question: Fresh
quests.hint: This word describes food straight from the farm or garden.
quests.explanation: Nice work! A carrot just pulled from the garden hasn't been cooked or preserved, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Food like this often needs to be eaten sooner, since it hasn't been preserved!

quests.instruction: A caramel apple, a fudge brownie, and a sugary soda are all fun, occasional foods. What's this word?
quests.question: Treat
quests.hint: This word describes food enjoyed sometimes, not as an everyday habit.
quests.explanation: You found it! A caramel apple, a fudge brownie, and soda are all occasional foods, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Balancing food like this with healthy meals is a good habit to build!

quests.instruction: A batch of homemade applesauce is sealed inside this glass container. What's this word?
quests.question: Jar
quests.hint: This word names a glass container often used for homemade food.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Homemade applesauce sealed inside this glass container is named by this word!
quests.funFact: People have used containers like this to store food safely for hundreds of years!

quests.instruction: A serving of diced fruit at a cafeteria often comes in this small container. Which word fits?
quests.question: Cup
quests.hint: This word names a small container, bigger than a spoon, smaller than a bowl.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Diced fruit at a cafeteria comes in this small container, named by this word!
quests.funFact: This word is one of the most common measurements used in recipes!

quests.instruction: Bags of peas and corn are kept in the freezer until they're solid and icy. Which word fits?
quests.question: Frozen
quests.hint: This word is the opposite of food that's fresh off the plant.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Bags of peas and corn are kept solid and icy in the freezer, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Vegetables kept this way are often frozen within hours of being picked!

quests.instruction: Pickled cucumbers are stored inside this glass container on the pantry shelf. Which word fits?
quests.question: Jar
quests.hint: This word names a clear glass container you can see the food through.
quests.explanation: Yes! Pickled cucumbers stored inside this clear glass container are named by this word!
quests.funFact: This glass container lets you see exactly what's stored inside!

quests.instruction: A cupcake, a candy bar, and a scoop of ice cream are all fun, sometimes-only foods. Which word fits?
quests.question: Treat
quests.hint: This word is the opposite of a food you'd eat every single day.
quests.explanation: That's right! A cupcake, a candy bar, and ice cream are all sometimes-only foods, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This kind of food is often saved for birthdays, holidays, or a special reward!

quests.instruction: A block of ice and a container of frozen yogurt are both solid from the cold. What's this word?
quests.question: Frozen
quests.hint: This word describes something that used to be liquid or soft, now solid.
quests.explanation: Great job! A block of ice and frozen yogurt are both solid from the cold, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Freezers can keep food safe to eat for a very long time!

quests.instruction: Vegetables, fruit, and water are good choices that help your body grow strong. What word describes food like this?
quests.question: Healthy
quests.hint: This word describes food that's good for your whole body.
quests.explanation: You got it! Vegetables, fruit, and water all help your body grow strong, which is what this word means!
quests.funFact: Eating a rainbow of colors is one easy way to enjoy food like this!

quests.instruction: Ice cream and popsicles are kept extremely cold until they turn hard as ice. What word describes them?
quests.question: Frozen
quests.hint: This word describes food kept so cold that it turns solid.
quests.explanation: Well done! Ice cream and popsicles are kept so cold that they turn solid, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Keeping food this way can help it stay good to eat for months!

quests.instruction: A measured amount of flour in a recipe is often scooped using this same-named tool. Which word matches?
quests.question: Cup
quests.hint: This word names both a drinking container and a measuring tool.
quests.explanation: Correct! A measured amount of flour is scooped using this tool, named by this same word!
quests.funFact: This handy word does double duty in the kitchen — for drinks and for measuring!

quests.instruction: Homemade strawberry jam is stored in this glass container to keep it fresh. What's the word?
quests.question: Jar
quests.hint: This word names the glass container you'd twist a lid onto.
quests.explanation: Super! Homemade strawberry jam is stored in this glass, twist-lid container, named by this word!
quests.funFact: Families have used this glass container to save fruit for winter for generations!

quests.instruction: A fruit salad, plain yogurt, and grilled salmon are all great choices for your body. Which word matches?
quests.question: Healthy
quests.hint: This word describes food picked to help your body, not just your taste buds.
quests.explanation: Nice work! A fruit salad, plain yogurt, and grilled salmon are all great choices for your body, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Eating food like this most days is a habit that can last your whole life!

quests.instruction: Zucchini bread comes out of the pan as one solid, uncut shape. Which word fits?
quests.question: Loaf
quests.hint: This word describes bread in the shape it was baked, before cutting.
quests.explanation: You found it! Zucchini bread in the solid, uncut shape it was baked in is named by this word!
quests.funFact: This shape of bread often has a golden, crusty top all the way around!

quests.instruction: Fresh parsley is often sold tied together in one small, leafy group. What's the word?
quests.question: Bunch
quests.hint: This word describes a small group of something, often tied together.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Parsley sold tied together in one leafy group is described by this word!
quests.funFact: Grocery stores often tie herbs like this together with a small rubber band!
